# Implementing Domain-Driven Design for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/ddd-implementing/ in the guided-plugins repository.

- Skills: 30 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$ddd-implementing:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 21 roles in `../agents/ddd-implementing-*.toml`. Codex plugins cannot bundle subagents, so install them with `node scripts/install-codex-agents.mjs ddd-implementing`.
- Always-on rules: see `../../rules/ddd-implementing/`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
